verdict.rationale: The DGX B200 documentation says its BMC supports Redfish and IPMI, and the CUDA documentation covers runtime and driver APIs. Together these give the system documented programmatic interfaces for management and for GPU compute. The evidence is thin, though: Redfish appears only as a one-line mention, there is no B200-specific API reference, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: a published B200/DGX management API reference or OpenAPI spec, documented coverage of the operations the API can drive, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving the system through its API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Supports Redfish, IPMI, SNMP, KVM, and Web user interface
This software enables node-wide administration of GPUs and can be used for cluster and data-center level management.
